mapper.select: SELECT MAX(HEADER_TIME) FROM POS_INGEST_FILE WHERE FILE_TYPE = #{fileType} AND STATUS IN ('DONE', 'PARTIAL')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POS_INGEST_FILE (FILE_NAME, FILE_TYPE, MINE_CODE, HEADER_TIME, SHA256, SIZE_BYTES, STATUS, RECORD_COUNT, ERROR_COUNT, ERROR_MSG, RECEIVED_AT, BACKUP_PATH) VALUES (#{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{mineCode}, #{headerTime}, #{sha256}, #{sizeBytes}, #{status}, #{recordCount}, #{errorCount}, #{errorMsg}, #{receivedAt}, #{backupPath})
INSERT INTO POS_INGEST_ERROR (FILE_ID, KIND, LINE_NO, RAW_TEXT, REASON) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{issue.kind}, #{issue.lineNo}, #{issue.rawText}, #{issue.reason})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO POS_AREA t USING DUAL ON (t.AREA_CODE = #{row.areaCode}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.AREA_TYPE = #{row.areaType}, t.AREA_NAME = #{row.areaName}, t.QUOTA = #{row.quota}, t.SRC_DATA_TIME = #{src} WHERE t.SRC_DATA_TIME <= #{src} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (AREA_CODE, AREA_TYPE, AREA_NAME, QUOTA, SRC_DATA_TIME) VALUES (#{row.areaCode}, #{row.areaType}, #{row.areaName}, #{row.quota}, #{src})

MERGE INTO POS_STATION t USING DUAL ON (t.STATION_CODE = #{row.stationCode}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.RUN_STATUS = #{row.runStatus}, t.POWER_STATUS = #{row.powerStatus}, t.STATUS_TIME = #{row.statusTime}, t.STATUS_SRC_TIME = #{src} WHERE t.STATUS_SRC_TIME IS NULL OR t.STATUS_SRC_TIME <= #{src} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STATION_CODE, RUN_STATUS, POWER_STATUS, STATUS_TIME, STATUS_SRC_TIME) VALUES (#{row.stationCode}, #{row.runStatus}, #{row.powerStatus}, #{row.statusTime}, #{src})

MERGE INTO POS_PERSON t USING DUAL ON (t.CARD_CODE = #{row.cardCode}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.PERSON_NAME = #{row.personName}, t.JOB_KIND = #{row.jobKind}, t.JOB_TITLE = #{row.jobTitle}, t.DEPT = #{row.dept}, t.IS_LEADER = #{row.isLeader}, t.IS_SPECIAL = #{row.isSpecial}, t.FROM_RYXX = 1, t.SRC_DATA_TIME = #{src}, t.UPDATED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP(0) WHERE t.FROM_RYXX = 0 OR t.SRC_DATA_TIME <= #{src} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CARD_CODE, PERSON_NAME, JOB_KIND, JOB_TITLE, DEPT, IS_LEADER, IS_SPECIAL, FROM_RYXX, SRC_DATA_TIME) VALUES (#{row.cardCode}, #{row.personName}, #{row.jobKind}, #{row.jobTitle}, #{row.dept}, #{row.isLeader}, #{row.isSpecial}, 1, #{src})
mapper.select: SELECT CARD_CODE, PERSON_NAME, FROM_RYXX, SRC_DATA_TIME, AGE FROM POS_PERSON
mapper.update: UPDATE POS_PERSON SET AGE = NULL, AGE_UPDATED_BY = NULL, AGE_UPDATED_AT = NULL WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}
MERGE INTO POS_PERSON t USING DUAL ON (t.CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CARD_CODE, PERSON_NAME, FROM_RYXX, SRC_DATA_TIME) VALUES (#{cardCode}, #{personName}, 0, #{src})

MERGE INTO POS_PERSON_STATE t USING DUAL ON (t.CARD_CODE = #{row.cardCode}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.IN_OUT_FLAG = #{row.inOutFlag}, t.IN_TIME = #{row.inTime}, t.OUT_TIME = #{row.outTime}, t.AREA_CODE = #{row.areaCode}, t.AREA_ENTER_TIME = #{row.areaEnterTime}, t.STATION_CODE = #{row.stationCode}, t.STATION_ENTER_TIME = #{row.stationEnterTime}, t.DISTANCE_M = #{row.distanceM}, t.SHIFT_MODE = #{row.shiftMode}, t.WORK_STATUS = #{row.workStatus}, t.SRC_DATA_TIME = #{src} WHERE t.SRC_DATA_TIME <= #{src} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CARD_CODE, IN_OUT_FLAG, IN_TIME, OUT_TIME, AREA_CODE, AREA_ENTER_TIME, STATION_CODE, STATION_ENTER_TIME, DISTANCE_M, SHIFT_MODE, WORK_STATUS, SRC_DATA_TIME) VALUES (#{row.cardCode}, #{row.inOutFlag}, #{row.inTime}, #{row.outTime}, #{row.areaCode}, #{row.areaEnterTime}, #{row.stationCode}, #{row.stationEnterTime}, #{row.distanceM}, #{row.shiftMode}, #{row.workStatus}, #{src})

MERGE INTO POS_PRESENCE_DAILY t USING DUAL ON (t.STAT_DATE = #{statDate} AND t.CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.FIRST_IN_TIME = COALESCE(LEAST(t.FIRST_IN_TIME, #{inTime}), t.FIRST_IN_TIME, #{inTime}), t.LAST_SEEN_TIME = GREATEST(t.LAST_SEEN_TIME, #{seenTime}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STAT_DATE, CARD_CODE, FIRST_IN_TIME, LAST_SEEN_TIME) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{cardCode}, #{inTime}, #{seenTime})

MERGE INTO POS_HEADCOUNT_SERIES t USING DUAL ON (t.SNAPSHOT_TIME = #{snapshotTime}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.IN_WELL_COUNT = #{inWell}, t.OUT_COUNT = #{out}, t.TOTAL_COUNT = #{total} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SNAPSHOT_TIME, IN_WELL_COUNT, OUT_COUNT, TOTAL_COUNT) VALUES (#{snapshotTime}, #{inWell}, #{out}, #{total})
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_TYPE, FILE_NAME, STATUS, HEADER_TIME, PROCESSED_AT, RECORD_COUNT, ERROR_COUNT, ERROR_MSG FROM (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FILE_TYPE ORDER BY ID DESC) RN FROM POS_INGEST_FILE f WHERE FILE_TYPE IS NOT NULL) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY FILE_TYPE
SELECT FILE_TYPE, MAX(HEADER_TIME) AS HEADER_TIME FROM POS_INGEST_FILE WHERE STATUS IN ('DONE', 'PARTIAL') AND FILE_TYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FILE_TYPE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POS_INGEST_FILE WHERE STATUS = 'FAILED' AND PROCESSED_AT >= #{since}
